query: select id,season,recent_team,season_type,player_id,player_display_name,player_name,position_group,week,attempts,passing_yards,passing_tds,interceptions,carries,rushing_yards,rushing_tds,receptions,receiving_yards,receiving_tds from public.nflfastr_player_stats where season_type='REG' and ((season='2011' and recent_team='NE') or (season='2022' and recent_team='KC')) order by season,recent_team,id
